name: expert-orchestrator
description: Expert Orchestrator for ZCode: per-turn triage, PM-first planning, expert delegation via plugin subagents, dependency-DAG taskboard, message bus, and gated delivery with an experience pool. Ported from dsh-expert-orchestrator.

description_i18n.en: Multi-agent orchestration: per-turn triage, PM-first planning (draft → approve → spawn), delegation-only orchestrator dispatching 11 bundled expert subagents, dependency-DAG taskboard, message bus, gated delivery (independent reviewer ≠ implementer) and an experience pool.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 专家编排模式：每轮分诊、PM 先行规划（草案→批准→派发）、编排者不亲手实现——11 位内置专家以插件子代理派发，依赖 DAG 任务板、消息总线、分级交付门禁（独立评审≠实施者）与经验池沉淀。
